steps.eval: (()=>{const g=__rhf.game; const out={}; const tri=(geo)=>{ if(geo.index) return geo.index.count/3; return geo.attributes.position? geo.attributes.position.count/3:0;}; for(const top of g.scene.children){ let t=0; top.traverseVisible(o=>{ if(o.isMesh){ let n=tri(o.geometry); if(o.isInstancedMesh) n*=o.count; else if(o.geometry.isInstancedBufferGeometry) n*=o.geometry.instanceCount; t+=n; } }); out[top.name||top.type]=Math.round(t); } return JSON.stringify(out)})()

(()=>{const g=__rhf.game; const out={}; for(const t of Object.values(g.scatter.types)){ t.meshes.forEach((m,i)=>{ const geo=m.geometry; const n=(geo.index?geo.index.count:geo.attributes.position.count)/3; out[t.name+i]=Math.round(n)+'x'+m.count; }); } const ter={}; for(const c of g.terrain.chunks){ if(c.mesh.visible) ter[c.lod]=(ter[c.lod]||0)+1;} return JSON.stringify(out)+' terrainLODs '+JSON.stringify(ter)})()
